thread:
alex: Brief sync: onboarding bench is blocking PRs. Proposal: two lanes - smoke (inline, ~1-2m) and full (async, longer). Add a tiny adapter handshake so ingest/runtime/prober share expectations (warmup_tokens, simulate_prefix, retries).

tara: +1. For smoke keep samples small (50 stratified) and return a compact triage blob (3 examples + token diffs). Full emits full artifacts.

sam: Handshake sketch:
```
handshake:
  lane: \"smoke\"|\"full\"
  warmup_tokens: 128
  simulate_prefix: \"none\"|\"short\"|\"full\"
  allow_quantized: true
```

indra: Also standardize retry behavior: smoke: 1 retry on infra, full: 0 retries to preserve signal. Add promotion policy: stable requires a full pass within 48h.

bench-bot: scheduled: full run for rwi-test-model on bench-fleet (ETA 30m) - will post artifact link when done.

tara: I'll write the RFC with schema + CLI example `rwi prober run --lane smoke --samples 50` and tag bench/orch.
